conditions.scoring: arithmetic mean of fold RMSE; RMSE = sqrt(sklearn MSE), Wh
conditions.sampling: numpy default_rng.choice without replacement within subset; reject repeated subsets

mutual_information.selection_source: existing full-training selection; not unbiased selector assessment

rfe.selection_source: existing full-training selection; not unbiased selector assessment

fixed_sfs_k6.reason: Phase 3B full-training SFS was k=10; no full-training SFS k=6 is invented; use B fold-local k=6 instead

correlation.scope: full Training descriptive only; no Holdout

exhaustive_search.estimate_limit: linear projection of measured 1000-subset runtime; excludes startup and selector costs; not a benchmark guarantee

selection_bias: A fixed method subsets reused full Training targets; random minimum reuses 1000 CV assessments. Neither is unbiased generalization error; do not rank them against B as equivalent estimators.
